name: Landbright · Ask a person for an agent (CIBA)
description: On ciba.requested from Landbright (an agent asked a person to let it act for them, OpenID CIBA): email the person the link to Landbright's decision page, with the agent's name, its sponsor's rules and the code the agent shows. The person decides on Landbright, signed in; this flow only carries the link and can't decide.

parameters.body: {{ JSON.stringify({ From: { Email: 'landflow@landflow.test', Name: 'Landflow' }, To: [{ Email: $json.to, Name: $json.toName }], Subject: $json.subject, Text: $json.text }) }}
